thought.text: Let me confirm the frontend login page renders the actual app and check container stability.

reasoning_content:
Frontend `/login` returns 200. Good. The webui is running. Ollama is not a separate container (it's bundled in the -ollama image variant). The guide mentions --no-ai disables "Ollama / Open WebUI" — so ollama is embedded in webui image. That's fine.

Let me check container restart counts/health and the frontend login page content to confirm it renders the actual app. Also verify the docker compose services list matches expected.

I have strong evidence of success. Let me do a final check: docker compose ps, and confirm frontend login page actually contains login form.

action.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== login page content ===" && curl -s -m 15 http://localhost:3000/login | grep -oiE "login|password|email|sign in|register" | sort -u | head
echo "=== compose ps ==="; docker compose ps --format 'table {{.Service}}\t{{.Status}}' 2>/dev/null
echo "=== restart counts ==="; for c in truspace-frontend truspace-backend ipfs0 cluster0 workspace-webui-1; do echo -n "$c: "; docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}} restarts, {{.State.Status}}' $c; done
echo "=== disk volumes ==="; du -sh volumes/* 2>/dev/null
